description: Complete Admin Panel with all 13 modules - Replace existing AdminScreen.kt with a full admin center featuring Dashboard, User Management, Campaign Control, Content Submissions, Deposit Requests, Withdrawal Requests, E-Commerce Admin, Disputes, KYC Verification, Wallets & Escrow, System Settings, Audit Logs, and Push Broadcast. Each module fetches real data from Supabase and performs real write operations.
steps: Create app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/data/repository/AdminRepository.kt - A comprehensive repository with methods for: fetching dashboard stats (user count, campaign count, total escrow, pending payouts), listing/managing users (search, filter by role/status, verify, suspend, ban, role change, wallet freeze), campaign control (list, pause, resume, force complete, cancel with refund), content submissions (list applications with deliverables, approve, reject, disburse payout), deposit requests (list pending, approve with wallet credit, reject), withdrawal requests (list pending, approve with ref, reject), shop admin (CRUD products, update order status), disputes (list, resolve), KYC queue (list pending docs, approve, reject), wallet control (list all wallets, manual credit/debit, freeze), system settings (get/set platform config from a 'platform_settings' table), audit logs (fetch logs, create log entries), broadcast notifications (insert notification records). All using SupabaseClient.client.from() pattern with proper DTOs.

Create app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ui/viewmodel/AdminViewModel.kt - A new standalone ViewModel (replacing the inline one in AdminScreen.kt) with StateFlows for each module's data, loading states, selected tab/module index, search queries, and action methods that call AdminRepository. Include AdminUiState with all module states.

Rewrite app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ui/screens/admin/AdminScreen.kt completely - The main admin screen with a ScrollableTabRow or navigation for all 13 modules. Each module as a separate @Composable function: DashboardTab (stat cards for users/campaigns/escrow/payouts, progress bars for revenue), UserManagementTab (search bar, filter chips, user list with action buttons), CampaignControlTab (campaign list with status chips, action buttons for pause/resume/complete/cancel), SubmissionsTab (submission cards with approve/reject/disburse), DepositsTab (pending deposit cards with proof URL, approve/reject), WithdrawalsTab (pending withdrawal cards with bank details, approve/reject), ShopAdminTab (product list with add/edit/delete, order list with status updates), DisputesTab (dispute cards with resolution actions), KycTab (document queue with approve/reject), WalletsTab (wallet overview list with freeze/credit/debit), SettingsTab (form fields for commission %, min withdrawal, toggles for maintenance mode and auto-approve, banner text field), AuditLogsTab (log entries list with filters), BroadcastTab (title/body inputs, audience selector, send button). All tabs must have loading/empty/error states, use clean white UI with RexoColors.AccentOrange accent, Surface cards with RexoColors.CardBorder.
Ensure all admin actions write audit log entries to the audit_logs table via AdminRepository.logAction() method.
Update NavGraph.kt if needed to pass any new parameters to AdminScreen.
acceptance_criteria: AdminScreen.kt renders 13 navigable modules via tabs
Each module fetches real data from Supabase using the repository pattern
Admin actions (approve/reject/suspend/freeze/etc.) perform real Supabase updates
All modules have loading, empty, and error states
UI uses clean white design with orange-red accent, no glassmorphism
Code compiles without errors (verified by inspection of imports and API usage)
AdminViewModel is a proper separate ViewModel class
verification: Inspect AdminScreen.kt for all 13 module composables with proper state handling
Inspect AdminRepository.kt for Supabase CRUD operations matching table schemas
Inspect AdminViewModel.kt for proper StateFlow management
Verify imports resolve to existing dependencies in build.gradle.kts
findings: Successfully created AdminRepository.kt (all 13 module data operations with DTOs), AdminViewModel.kt (standalone ViewModel with StateFlows for each module), and completely rewrote AdminScreen.kt with 13 navigable tab modules. Used wildcard imports from data.repository.* and ui.viewmodel.* to resolve DTOs. No new dependencies added. AdminDashboardStats is not @Serializable (it is only used in-memory, not for Supabase deserialization). All Supabase DTOs use snake_case matching table columns. NavGraph.kt required no changes since the AdminScreen signature (onNavigateBack) was preserved.
